Journal · Mind & body

The mind is not separate from the body.

Writing on attention, sleep, breath and the small disciplines that make a day livable. Not medical advice; a record of practice and reading.

The territory

Breath and attention, rest and recovery, the architecture of a day, and the difference between feeling better and being cured. The writing stays with practice and experience, not diagnosis.

How to read it

Nothing here replaces a clinician. Where a practice has evidence, the evidence is named. Where it is tradition, it is labelled as tradition.

Essays are being prepared. The section will grow slowly and stay readable.

OPAR

Objects and knowledge for a slower, more sensory life.
